schemas.$comment: The docs screen's show_guide action: shows one guide of the docs screen. Sent as the next step after the screen domain's mount_ext; the screen's handler replaces its own entry through its app's navigation facade. Self-contained and closed, as template-mfe's action schemas are.

target.$comment: The screen that shows the page: the only target of this action

guide.$comment: The guide to show: one of the docs screen's guides

seo.title: Docs
seo.description: FrontX documentation: run a shell with its first MFE, make a first change with a coding agent, and use the FrontX libraries on their own.

/get-started.title: Get started: run a shell and its first MFE
/get-started.description: Create a FrontX workspace with the FrontX CLI, apply template-shell and template-mfe, and run the host with its example screens.

/first-change.title: Make your first change
/first-change.description: Change a FrontX screen's text in its locale file, check the package and see the result in the running shell, with a task for a coding agent.
